environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule 'block-executable-uploads' using a RegexPatternSet on the URI path matching '/api/v2/documents/upload' combined with a ByteMatchStatement inspecting the request body for magic bytes (ELF header \x7fELF, MZ header for PE, PK header for ZIP/JAR, and PHP open tags <?php/<?=) with TextTransformation NONE and positional constraint CONTAINS, action BLOCK, priority 1. (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode which covers Log4j patterns and path traversal in headers. The custom rule inspects the first 8KB of the body (WAF body inspection limit set to 8KB via OverrideAction on the WebACL). Nginx in this environment does NOT have php-fpm and serves all files in /uploads/ as application/octet-stream via 'default_type application/octet-stream; types {}' directive.

waf_rules.name: block-executable-uploads
waf_rules.statement: RegexPatternSet URI match AND ByteMatch body CONTAINS magic bytes

config.nginx: location /uploads/public/ { alias /opt/app/uploads/public/; default_type application/octet-stream; types {} autoindex off; }
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, no php-fpm, no script interpreters installed
config.network: security group allows only ALB security group ingress
